item.title: China Mobile Sends 1.6Tb/s on One Wavelength Over 960 km of Standard Fiber Using 230GBaud
item.description: China Mobile ran a real-time 1.6Tb/s single-wavelength signal over 960 km of standard G.652.D fiber at 230GBaud, its longest 1.6T result, to feed a new ITU-T long-haul standard.

item.title: Tencent Launches Yuanbao Search, a Standalone AI Search Product at so.qq.com

item.title: AgiBot Open-Sources LIFE, a Lifelong Embodied AI Framework Built Around RoboBeats Models
item.description: AgiBot's open-source LIFE gives robots continuous sensing via RoboBeats models, reanalyzable memory and reusable tools. Its own tests show 60.5% on SSS-Bench and faster day-long recall.
